act_title: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
title: Obligation of the Bank to transact Government business
text:
20. Obligation of the Bank to transact Government business.—The Bank shall undertake to accept

monies for account of [ the Central Government ] and to make payments up to the amount
standing to the credit of [its account], and to carry out [its exchange], remittance and other banking
operations, including the management of the public debt [of the Union].
